info.title: SimpleLocalize Universal API
info.description: Manage translations, languages, keys, and localization workflows

post.description: Creates an auto-translation job for text in SimpleLocalize.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

targetProjectLanguage.description: Project target language key (optional). It's required to load additional information about the target language (e.g. DeepL glossary).

description.description: Description that will be used as a context for translation. It's useful for better translation quality.

sourceProjectLanguage.description: Project source language key (optional). It's required to load additional information about the source language (e.g. DeepL glossary).

sourceLanguage.description: Provider source language key (optional). If not provided, the source language will be detected automatically.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

languageKeys[].description: Project source language keys, if not provided then all languages will be translated. Auto-translation configuration will be used from the last auto-translation job.

post.description: Creates a new environment in SimpleLocalize.

key.description: Unique key for the environment. Must be lowercase, contain only letters, numbers, and dashes.

name.description: Name of the environment. Can contain letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, and dashes.

color.description: Color of the environment in hex format for Web UI. Must be 6 characters long and valid hex color.
